Product Manager II, AI & Data Security

Datadog · Paris

Product Manager II, AI & Data Security at Datadog. Paris. Apply for this Product Manager II, AI & Data Security opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

&lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="41" data-local-id="e43db32d6868"&gt;As organizations rapidly adopt AI applications and agentic systems, security teams need visibility and control over how these technologies are being used. Datadog's AI & Data Security product helps customers discover, secure, and govern AI usage across their environments ensuring sensitive data is properly managed from model training through production.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="398" data-local-id="27c03b79d92a"&gt;As a Product Manager II for AI & Data Security, you will own capabilities for AI discovery, posture management, and data security; giving customers complete visibility into their AI applications, agents, and enabling ecosystem, with prioritized actions to operate AI systems securely.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="684" data-local-id="44aee37ec729"&gt;You'll partner with engineering, design, security research, and &lt;span class="acronym-highlight"&gt;GTM&lt;/span&gt; teams to define and ship platform capabilities that help organizations adopt AI at scale.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="843" data-local-id="8ddf43dbde22"&gt;At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1094" data-local-id="4c9e4fc0bcdf"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;What You’ll Do:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="c07a7426c8ba" data-indent-level="1"&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1112" data-local-id="516711aa0752"&gt;Own the roadmap for AI & Data Security capabilities, including AI and data discovery & posture management.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1222" data-local-id="0547ad38f712"&gt;Define how security teams can assess and manage the security posture of AI-enabled systems, including configuration risks, sensitive data exposure, and policy violations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1396" data-local-id="9c8df5783f61"&gt;Work closely with engineers and designers to deliver new product capabilities end-to-end, from early concept through launch and iteration.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1538" data-local-id="6c236ef471d5"&gt;Partner with Datadog security researchers to identify emerging risks in AI systems and translate them into actionable product features.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1677" data-local-id="98918a7daaee"&gt;Engage with customers to understand how they are adopting AI and validate solutions that help them operate these systems securely.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1811" data-local-id="90a71da9fb0f"&gt;Collaborate with go-to-market teams to enable adoption and communicate the value of AI security capabilities to customers.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1937" data-local-id="1656e90c63eb"&gt;&lt;strong data-renderer-mark="true"&gt;Who You Are:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="fc5d1f9a70d8" data-indent-level="1"&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="1952" data-local-id="576727931839"&gt;You have 3+ years of product management experience building technical products, ideally in security, AI, data, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2112" data-local-id="bf0d0c5030ae"&gt;You have a strong understanding of generative AI, modern cloud environments and application architectures.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2222" data-local-id="bf178be840ba"&gt;You are interested in the security challenges introduced by AI and machine learning systems.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2318" data-local-id="05f27f5de4f0"&gt;You enjoy working closely with engineers and are comfortable discussing technical implementation details and tradeoffs.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2441" data-local-id="1647f09501dd"&gt;You regularly engage with customers and use their feedback to drive product decisions and prioritization.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2550" data-local-id="befd96352a06"&gt;Experienced engaging customers and translating feedback into product decisions.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2633" data-local-id="510cd0d2a8f1"&gt;&lt;em&gt;Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2866" data-local-id="1a210977cd7d"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Benefits and Growth:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="4ef4bf57efa4" data-indent-level="1"&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2890" data-local-id="f5aa6ed04382"&gt;Generous and competitive benefits package&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="2935" data-local-id="22e32cbb6172"&gt;New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="3000" data-local-id="f8d22f241ba9"&gt;Continuous career development and pathing opportunities&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="3059" data-local-id="8b50929b1d11"&gt;Employee-focused best in class onboarding&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="3104" data-local-id="b0257c43f425"&gt;Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="3160" data-local-id="dcce30279c90"&gt;Friendly and inclusive workplace culture&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p data-renderer-start-pos="3204" data-local-id="f075ecd9f530"&gt;&lt;em&gt;Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="content-conclusion"&gt;&lt;hr&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Datadog: &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale.
